software_connections_target_check.name: software_connections_target_check
software_connections_target_check.value: ("software_connections"."execution_target" = 'host' AND "software_connections"."machine_id" IS NULL AND "software_connections"."owner_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("software_connections"."execution_target" = 'machine' AND "software_connections"."machine_id" IS NOT NULL AND "software_connections"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

task_execution_actions_loop_check.name: task_execution_actions_loop_check
task_execution_actions_loop_check.value: ("task_execution_actions"."kind" = 'loop') = ("task_execution_actions"."loop_name" IS NOT NULL AND "task_execution_actions"."loop_version" IS NOT NULL)

task_execution_actions_workspace_check.name: task_execution_actions_workspace_check
task_execution_actions_workspace_check.value: "task_execution_actions"."workspace_kind" IN ('isolated','existing','new','local') AND (("task_execution_actions"."workspace_kind" = 'existing') = ("task_execution_actions"."worktree_id" IS NOT NULL)) AND (("task_execution_actions"."workspace_kind" = 'new') = ("task_execution_actions"."worktree_name" IS NOT NULL)) AND (("task_execution_actions"."workspace_kind" = 'local') = ("task_execution_actions"."local_machine_id" IS NOT NULL AND "task_execution_actions"."local_link_id" IS NOT NULL AND "task_execution_actions"."local_link_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "task_execution_actions"."local_checkout_handle" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("task_execution_actions"."workspace_kind" = 'local' OR ("task_execution_actions"."local_machine_id" IS NULL AND "task_execution_actions"."local_link_id" IS NULL AND "task_execution_actions"."local_link_revision" IS NULL AND "task_execution_actions"."local_checkout_handle" IS NULL))

task_operations_plan_association_check.name: task_operations_plan_association_check
task_operations_plan_association_check.value: ("task_operations"."kind" = 'plan' and "task_operations"."publication_attempt_id" is not null and "task_operations"."input_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') or ("task_operations"."kind" <> 'plan' and "task_operations"."publication_attempt_id" is null and "task_operations"."input_hash" is null)

task_planning_decisions_content_check.name: task_planning_decisions_content_check
task_planning_decisions_content_check.value: length(btrim("task_planning_decisions"."summary")) > 0 and jsonb_typeof("task_planning_decisions"."reasons") = 'array' and jsonb_array_length("task_planning_decisions"."reasons") between 1 and 20 and jsonb_typeof("task_planning_decisions"."uncertainties") = 'array' and jsonb_array_length("task_planning_decisions"."uncertainties") between 0 and 20

task_planning_decisions_status_check.name: task_planning_decisions_status_check
task_planning_decisions_status_check.value: ("task_planning_decisions"."status" = 'review' and "task_planning_decisions"."approved_by_user_id" is null and "task_planning_decisions"."approved_at" is null) or ("task_planning_decisions"."status" = 'approved' and "task_planning_decisions"."approved_by_user_id" is not null and "task_planning_decisions"."approved_at" is not null)

tasks_origin_check.name: tasks_origin_check
tasks_origin_check.value: ("tasks"."origin" = 'flow_dev' and "tasks"."author_user_id" is not null and "tasks"."status" <> 'imported') or ("tasks"."origin" = 'external' and "tasks"."author_user_id" is null and "tasks"."status" = 'imported')

tasks_planning_status_check.name: tasks_planning_status_check
tasks_planning_status_check.value: "tasks"."planning_status" is null or ("tasks"."status" in ('published','imported') and "tasks"."planning_status" in ('in_progress','failed','review','approved'))
